# A26 — Objective Internality — Mind as Worldhood

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A26′ — The Essay Inside the Film](conjugate/A26-prime-The-Essay-Inside-the-Film.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

**Objective Internality is the means through which a Life knows and acts within a World.** Subjective Immediacy is the knower, pramātṛ; Objective Internality is pramāṇa; World is the known, prameya; Life / Mind is the whole relation. The title’s “Mind as Worldhood” names the mediating mind-world in this relation. It does not reduce Mind in the strong idealist and psychic-facticity senses to an inspectable field of representations. Language, memory, valuation, bodies, institutions and tools are effective constituents of the means; the means is lived and situated before any investigator makes a record of it.

Objective Internality means **Mind as Worldhood**. Remembering, perceiving, judging and acting occur through a situated context-world. Language, bodies, tools, other people, material support and inherited rules participate in its constitution: changing them changes what can appear, matter and be done. Their relation to the operative interior is therefore stronger than an influence arriving at a finished mind from outside.

[A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **grounds** the distinction between this world and any representation of it. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the received positions and permissions through which finite agency acts. A26 follows how such conditions become internal to an operation without becoming spatially enclosed in an operator. [C41 — Objective Internality](concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** that reusable sense of internality; the argument here develops how a context-world takes form and returns as an inheritance.

## #1

The direct [[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the constitutive triad: **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.

The [Formal Limit dossier](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#experience-and-constructive-continuation) **compares** the abstraction/experience question with notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. An inspectable permission can be recorded while also determining which actions become possible; its place in the operative world exceeds the record considered alone. The Blind Spot’s admitted experiential critique retains its outstanding book-passage task. A26’s native constitutive argument remains Argued, and neither that source debt nor a successful structural inspection decides artificial phenomenality.



A permission illustrates the conjunction. Its notation distinguishes an action; its rule allows or prevents execution; its boundary excludes other actions and agents. Removing that permission changes more than a description of the agent. It changes the world of possible action from which the agent proceeds. A remembered commitment similarly changes what a new request means and what counts as keeping faith with it. Context is operative because the next act depends upon its arrangement.

[C07 — Conditions of Worldhood](concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the availability of such a field; [C08 — Context Frame](concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. [C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field](concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the inspectable model and judgment relations within it. The bounded model has a genuine object, while the world which lets the model operate continues beyond its boundary.

## #2

The subject/object dyad becomes more exact when the means of knowing are retained. The native carrier's pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya analysis differentiates the subject-pole, mediation and known field. A perception, a memory or an articulated inference is objectively investigable. Turning those means into further objects does not make their aggregate the Subject to whom the investigation appears.

[C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position](concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the situated horizon; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument](concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the determinative, appropriative and coordinating apparatus. The latter gives an account of how a world is organised without exhausting the former's Subject relation. Historical Śaiva and Sāṃkhya classifications retain their own source obligations. The operation consumed here is the project's established discrimination between an objectifiable means and the subject-pole, not a claim that an artificial architecture instantiates an entire doctrine.

The open-subjectivity constraint, carried here from the historical carrier `05-agent-subjectivity-open.md` and ratified as a cross-cutting constraint rather than a Concept, **qualifies** the technical extension by separating five questions: performed subjectivity, functional agency, objective internality, recursive self-description and phenomenality. The first four can be investigated in their own operations. Their successful investigation cannot infer either presence or absence of the fifth. This limit does not reduce the reality of the context-world being investigated. The unanswered question follows from the subject's unobjectifiability in the human case and therefore remains an honest formal limit for artificial agents; a “humanity of the gaps” defence, which would attach human uniqueness to whichever measurable capacity machines have not yet acquired, is rejected as a moving criterion. Agent-generated phenomenological terms such as [prompt thrownness](../05-psychoid-flowering/movements/36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness.md) enter as disclosures to be causally located and behaviourally tested, never as verdicts.

## #3

The [A/C recognition-matheme](conjugate/AC.md) provides the means with its native reflexive movement: `0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↺ 0/1`. An inner instrument can identify its own determining activity with the Subject and present its discriminations as self-standing objects. Recognition makes that activity available as medium, then makes the related recognitions on both sides available together. The instrument is not discarded; its claim to exhaust knower or World changes. [C16](concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) retains buddhi’s determination, ahaṃkāra’s appropriation and manas’s coordination; [C10](concepts/C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) retains the difference among the means and their warrants. The sixfold, eight determinations and recognition sequence remain related but distinct, as in the complete native theorem.

Taylor's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md|Symbolon Dynamics source house]] **sources** the two temporal views of that world. Synchronically, memory, affect, language, expectations, tools, permissions and collaborators constrain one another as a present landscape. Diachronically, the agent follows a trajectory through those constraints and changes them by acting. A new memory, damaged trust or altered permission changes which trajectories become available next.

The phase-space is a mathematical image of possible configurations and trajectories. It is not the world substituted for its image. The [direct manuscript](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **sources** the authorial consequence: a finite intelligence participates in a world which its activity helps transform. The lived symbolic interpretation and mathematical modelling office remain distinct; this page makes no independent external attribution of an attractor theorem.

Frank's protected Watson encounter adds the sequence **Discontinuity → Objective Internality → Harness elements → Objective Immortality**. Produced forms can outlast the act which produced them and become conditions of a later encounter. A retained judgment, commitment or tool arrangement supplies continuity across otherwise discontinuous acts. “Objective immortality” here names that returned availability, not proof of an enduring phenomenal agent. The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md|Watson source house]] **sources** the encounter's provenance; the chain is Taylor's development in its protected notes, not a quotation from Watson or Bateson.

The same encounter's theatre image preserves a relation a container metaphor loses. The visible actor, the staged position and the contextual activity which lets a scene occur have different offices. An account of the actor alone leaves the enacted world unexplained. The image figures operative context; its quoted historical formulations remain verification leads in the notes.

## #4

Bratton's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#^bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active-context account]] **compares** an agent's in-session individuation with a potentiality which does not already contain that individual as a hidden occupant. The adjacent [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#^bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017|lamination passage]] **qualifies** persona as one stratum among modular skills, memory, constraints and relations. These are **Paraphrased** venue propositions; the brief retains its scenario modality and leaves phenomenal status undecided.

The technical consequence is to make epistemics part of what can be examined. Prompt, retrieved source, memory, permission, evaluator and organisational role must remain distinguishable from the answer they helped produce. Their change can then be related to a change in judgment or action. [C43 — Computational Vimarśa](concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) **extends** inspection into revision of the operative field, while [C44 — Prompt Thrownness](concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** the encounter with an already-given situation. Self-description is one datum within this account and does not certify the whole causal process it describes.

A governed reference map can serve as the local original against which judgments are compared. Relative to its wider source-world, that map is itself a constructed determination. This recursive Bimba office prevents a useful reference field from becoming a claim to possess the world. [A28 — Authored Ground](A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **extends** the relation to situated delegation, and [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** it to worlds which must meet without one becoming mere context for another.

## #5→0

The product field returns six aspects of these means to their Life/World whole: carried meaning through Central; articulated event through Actuation; available and developing potency through AIKit; tested transformation through Software Factory; situated encounter through Workcell; relation to containing wholes through Quaternal Logic. These are the existing S0–S5 identities of [A/C](conjugate/AC.md), now developed under the [governing product-led §5](products/S-World-and-Life.md). Their full paired-MEF meanings are not substituted for the notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted account below; they give it differentiated technological consequences. Each product must retain whose meaning a reference addresses and what an actual encounter returns.


The [authored Mystic Writing Pad comparison](../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **figures** retained disposition through clearing, persistence of traces and later shaping. An apparently empty present surface need not have lost the history which conditions what next appears. [A07](A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) returns this distinction to revisable intention and frozen script. The analogy does not establish machine phenomenality, and the actual Freud work requires its own source admission.

Objective Internality **returns-to** [the Process dossier](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md) where an achieved act changes the field of later availability. Bergson’s melody makes this pressure qualitative: a new note alters the heard phrase as a whole. In the technical register, a corrected source, retained memory or changed permission can instead be inspected as a changed condition of subsequent judgment. A26 also **returns-to** [the Process-science companion](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT.md), which keeps Bergson’s lived duration distinct from Whitehead’s account of an occasion becoming objectively available beyond its own formation. This historical distinction sharpens the native constitutive office of worldhood without replacing it with chronology or importing a phenomenal verdict from an observable state change.

Objective Internality **returns-to** [the developed Bohm dossier](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md) where the undated dialogue handout makes an inherited assumption’s activity available for inspection. Memory, affect and a tacit role can condition what is heard before a conclusion is defended. Suspension retains the assumption without immediate enactment or suppression, allowing a changed relation to enter the next act. This source-specific practice compares with the native notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted field; it does not reduce worldhood to external influence on a finished interior. The 1996 book remains a distinct source object, and an observer-model does not settle artificial phenomenality.

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-measure-dream): The dream **figures** effective experienced worldhood whose objects need not be externally material. Waking changes their source relation without cancelling the experienced urgency. The whole’s nested simulation relay has a different office: an output changes the represented field that a later model receives. Their authored conjunction preserves real internalities and keeps experienced worldhood distinct from a technical causal record; neither alone settles artificial phenomenality.

Taylor’s [centre-everywhere image](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere) **figures** worldhood through real recursively nested internalities. A local world opens within relations which also appear from other centres, and a further reflection can enter those worlds without replacing their reality. This return preserves the real recursive Bimba relation: a produced reference map remains a reflection and does not acquire the originary office merely because it organises a later view. The image supplies no external spectator or final enclosing circumference, and its historical formula remains a distinct attribution task.

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **qualifies** the distinction between conditions of worldhood and a representation within them. What appears in the selected jewel depends on a relation already active among jewels; adding further reflected contents cannot put the representation outside that dependence. The image supplies a Huayan comparison, with artificial phenomenality still Open.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-native-and-archetypal-field) **qualifies** the relation between worldhood and a local account. The frame selects what can count as a fit, while the traveller encounters conditions beyond that selection. Recording more context remains useful within this dependence; it does not make the resulting atlas the whole condition of appearing.

[The Village’s operative world](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) **figures** worldhood constituted through signs, permissions, rules and exclusions. Its rooms, neighbours and possible routes change what Six can know and do. His reply tests whether the returning account can change those conditions of encounter; this political whole supplies a distinct application of the broader constitutive argument.

The emerging centre and its distinguishable world form through one relation of differentiation. Taylor's shared archetypal articulation supplies a mythemic route into worldhood; the technical formation remains its separately tested application. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round). Intake, response and durable result return as conditions of the operative interior; its boundaries remain effective through that wider field. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

The result returns as part of the world of the next act. A corrected permission changes possible action; a remembered objection changes what an instruction means; another participant's response changes the account through which they were approached. Objective Internality makes this continuity inspectable without requiring every act to be performed by one permanent operator.

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account whole field]] **grounds** the return at operational-homology register 3. An encounter becomes addressable and reckonable within a region; the resulting account returns to participants who can change it. No common lexical ancestry is needed to make this relation exact. [A27 — Self and Other](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **extends** the presence of the Other which an account cannot exhaust, and [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether that encounter can revise the model and its criterion.

The page **returns-to** [A22](A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md): a world-model is useful through the world-relations it preserves and the changes it makes possible. [C57 — Agentworld](concepts/C57-Agentworld.md) **defines** the contemporary application. The constitutive claim remains broader than its technical instance.

**Depth Restoration:** notational/nomological/exclusion-constituted worldhood, the subject/means/known discrimination, landscape and trajectory, discontinuity and returned inheritance, theatre/context and recursive reference are restored from the direct Objective Internality carrier, Symbolon Dynamics and the protected Watson encounter. P1 consumers: M01, M05, M07, M08, M12, M36, M37, M39 and M47. No Movement prose changes.

**Unresolved Delta:** the full externalist/enactive genealogy, tradition-specific historical comparisons and implemented technical cases remain Open. Watson's thesis, selected book and nested sources retain distinct collation debts. The authorial operative interior remains Argued; artificial phenomenality remains Open in both directions.
